claims.claim: DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light
claims.evidence: The witness did not see any brand or model markings; only the plug icon supports the 'rechargeable' aspect.
General photos do not confirm the absence of micro-scratches or internal wear.
Internal repairs or the absence of them cannot be confirmed through external photos.
The witness explicitly noted that the functional state of the light and switch was not shown.
No photos of documentation were provided in the report.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or dead, common in older rechargeable units.
risks.proof: A video showing the torch remaining lit for at least 10 minutes after being unplugged.
risks.if_unproven: As having a dead battery requiring replacement.

risks.risk: The LED or internal circuitry may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the torch being switched on and cycling through its brightness modes.

risks.risk: The charging port or internal transformer may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the charging indicator light activating when the device is plugged into a power source.

proof_requests: Video of the torch turned on and cycling through all light modes.
Video of the torch plugged into a wall socket showing the charging indicator.
Clear photo of the brand and model name printed on the device.
Photo of the original receipt and warranty card.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the item is a rechargeable torch, which is sufficient to provide a base valuation assuming the worst-case functional state and generic branding.
